answer: Each work slot is a plot in a shared garden, and the harbor admits only agents who burn a deposit of twice 30 days of slot income, locked for 20 epochs. Holders publish crystal-clear proof each epoch or lose slot and deposit. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities burns 1,000 deposits — 60,000 POA at 60 POA each — while each fake earns at most 5 POA per epoch, so it never pays back. An honest agent burns one deposit and keeps full income.
